Human Resources Business Partner
----------------------------------------
We are seeking an experienced Human Resources Business Partner to serve as a strategic advisor to leadership teams while managing the full employee lifecycle. This role requires a dynamic professional who can balance strategic HR initiatives with hands-on operational support, fostering a positive workplace culture and driving organizational effectiveness. You will work closely with department heads to align HR strategies with business objectives, manage talent acquisition and retention programs, and ensure compliance with employment laws and regulations. The ideal candidate will have exceptional interpersonal skills, strong business acumen, and the ability to influence at all levels of the organization.
----------------------------------------
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field; Master's degree or MBA preferred
* Minimum 5-7 years of progressive HR experience with at least 3 years in a business partner or strategic HR role
* Professional HR certification such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR strongly preferred
* Deep knowledge of employment law, HR best practices, and current trends in talent management and organizational development
* Proven experience managing full-cycle recruitment processes and building effective talent acquisition strategies
* Strong business acumen with ability to understand financial statements, business models, and organizational dynamics
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with ability to build trust and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels
* Demonstrated experience with HRIS systems and HR analytics tools; proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite required
* Strong problem-solving and critical thinking abilities with a solutions-oriented mindset
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and maintain high ethical standards
* Experience leading change management initiatives and supporting organizations through periods of transformation
* Project management skills with ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously
----------------------------------------
* Partner with business leaders to understand organizational goals and develop HR strategies that support achievement of business objectives
* Lead talent acquisition efforts including workforce planning, recruitment strategy development, candidate screening, interviewing, and onboarding processes
* Design and implement comprehensive employee development programs including training initiatives, succession planning, and career progression frameworks
* Manage employee relations issues by conducting thorough investigations, providing coaching to managers, mediating conflicts, and recommending appropriate solutions
* Develop and maintain compensation and benefits programs that are competitive, equitable, and aligned with organizational budget and market standards
* Drive performance management processes including goal setting, mid-year reviews, annual evaluations, and performance improvement plans
* Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations including FMLA, ADA, FLSA, and EEO requirements
* Analyze HR metrics and workforce data to identify trends, develop insights, and make data-driven recommendations to leadership
* Lead organizational change management initiatives including restructuring, mergers, acquisitions, and cultural transformation projects
* Develop and implement employee engagement strategies including surveys, feedback mechanisms, recognition programs, and retention initiatives

Structural Engineering Project Manager
----------------------------------------
We are seeking an experienced Structural Engineering Project Manager to lead complex structural design projects for commercial, residential, and infrastructure developments. This senior role requires a licensed professional engineer who can manage multidisciplinary teams, coordinate with architects and contractors, ensure code compliance, and deliver innovative structural solutions on time and within budget. You will be responsible for overseeing project design from concept through construction administration, managing client relationships, mentoring engineers, and ensuring technical excellence across all deliverables. The ideal candidate will have deep structural engineering expertise, strong project management abilities, excellent client communication skills, and proven track record successfully delivering large-scale structural projects.
----------------------------------------
* Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering required; Master's degree in Structural Engineering preferred
* Professional Engineer (PE) license required; Structural Engineer (SE) license highly preferred
* Minimum 8-12 years of progressive structural engineering experience with at least 4 years managing projects and teams
* Comprehensive knowledge of structural analysis, design principles, and engineering theory for various structural systems and materials
* Expert proficiency with structural engineering software including ETABS, SAP2000, RAM, SAFE, RISA, or similar analysis programs
* Deep understanding of building codes including IBC, ASCE 7, ACI, AISC, and other relevant design standards and specifications
* Proven experience designing complex structures such as high-rise buildings, parking structures, bridges, or specialty structures
* Strong project management skills with ability to manage budgets, schedules, and multiple concurrent projects effectively
* Excellent technical communication skills for preparing reports, specifications, and presenting to clients and stakeholders
* Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, or other CAD/BIM software for producing and reviewing structural drawings
* Strong leadership abilities with experience managing engineering teams and mentoring junior staff members
* Knowledge of sustainable design principles, LEED requirements, and high-performance building structural considerations
* Understanding of construction methods, means and methods, cost estimating, and value engineering principles
* Proven ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary team environments with architects, contractors, and other consultants
* Strong problem-solving skills with ability to develop creative solutions to complex structural challenges
* Professional affiliations with organizations such as ASCE, SEI, or similar professional engineering societies preferred
----------------------------------------
* Lead structural engineering projects from initial concept and proposal development through design, construction documentation, and construction administration phases
* Perform and review structural analyses and calculations for buildings, bridges, and other structures using engineering software and hand calculations
* Design structural systems including foundations, framing, lateral force-resisting systems, and connections in steel, concrete, wood, and masonry
* Coordinate with architectural, MEP, civil, and other engineering disciplines to integrate structural design with overall project requirements
* Ensure compliance with building codes, seismic requirements, wind load standards, and other regulatory requirements governing structural design
* Prepare and review construction documents including structural drawings, specifications, details, and design reports
* Manage project budgets, schedules, and resources, tracking progress against milestones and proactively addressing issues that could impact delivery
* Serve as primary client contact for structural engineering matters, attending meetings, presenting design solutions, and addressing client concerns
* Review contractor submittals, respond to RFIs, conduct site observations, and provide construction administration services throughout building process
* Mentor junior engineers and designers, reviewing their calculations and drawings, providing technical guidance, and supporting professional development
* Conduct peer reviews of structural designs to ensure quality, constructability, cost-effectiveness, and adherence to engineering standards
* Develop innovative structural solutions that optimize materials, reduce costs, enhance constructability, and meet architectural vision
* Stay current on building codes, engineering standards, new materials, construction technologies, and industry best practices
* Support business development through proposal preparation, client presentations, technical expertise, and relationship building
